articles.summary: ION Analytics reports that Burford Capital is targeting further law firm investments as part of a broader strategy to expand across new sectors and geographies. Learn more.
articles.title: ION Analytics reports on Burford Capital’s push into law firm investments and new markets

articles.summary: Burford’s Philipp Liebfried breaks down how GCs can apply economic discipline and legal finance tools to make smarter litigation decisions.
articles.title: The economics of litigation: A GC’s decision-making guide

articles.summary: Vice Chair David Perla and Managing Director Andrew Cohen are quoted in the latest issue of Corporate Disputes magazine, where they discuss the growth of the legal finance industry and the value it provides for law firms and businesses alike. Learn more.
articles.title: David Perla and Andrew Cohen highlight the value of legal finance for law firms and corporates in Corporate Disputes magazine

articles.summary: In an article entitled "From Confusion to Collaboration," Burford Vice Chair David Perla and Parabellum Capital Managing Partner and Corporate Counsel Dai Wai Chin Feman co-author a piece for Carrier Management and Insurance Journal about how persistent misconceptions about claims costs and so-called "social inflation" highlight the need for clarity between insurers and the legal finance industry. Learn more.
articles.title: David Perla co-authors article in Carrier Management and Insurance Journal calling for clarity—not confrontation—between the legal finance and insurance industries

articles.summary: Law.com International discusses draft legislation in Spain regarding class actions and highlights Burford's recent expansion into the Spanish market, noting that "Burford Capital, which manages a $7.5 billion portfolio globally, has already moved in, launching in Madrid in October with plans to expand." Learn more.
articles.title: Law.com International highlights Burford's presence in Spain

articles.summary: David Lat, author of Original Jurisdiction, highlights the growing shift inside corporations to view litigation not merely as a cost center but as a source of profit. Learn more.
articles.title: Original Jurisdiction spotlights how litigation can become a business asset

articles.summary: Nikkei discusses patent monetization opportunities for Japanese companies, as well as the evolution of patent litigation in the age of AI, with CEO Christopher Bogart. Learn more.
articles.title: Nikkei spotlights Burford Capital and patent monetization opportunities in Japan

articles.summary: Non-Billable writes about Pallas Partners, and how the firm is "one of a growing number of boutiques to launch with institutional-style infrastructure rather than traditional law firm back offices." The article notes that Pallas Partners worked "with legal consultancy Kindleworth on its setup, a model that has gained attention following litigation funder Burford Capital’s recent minority stake in Kindleworth as funders look for closer exposure to law firm economics." Learn more.
articles.title: Non-Billable writes about Burford's minority stake in Kindleworth

articles.summary: Non-Billable includes Burford's minority investment in Kindleworth as one of "the moments that defined Big Law this year," stating that the investment "was another indication of the level of investor appetite in the [legal] sector." Learn more.
articles.title: Non-Billable features Burford's Kindleworth investment in "the moments that defined Big Law this year"

articles.summary: Burford Capital CFO Jordan Licht joined LinkedIn’s CFO for a CNBC CFO Council panel discussion with CNBC's Frank Holland, outlining how Burford is deploying artificial intelligence across the business. Learn more.
articles.title: Burford CFO Jordan Licht discusses Burford's use of AI on CNBC CFO Council panel

articles.summary: Evan Meyerson, managing director who leads Burford’s U.S. Commercial team, writes in European Financial Review about why private equity firms should consider financing or monetizing legal assets, and how legal finance can unlock liquidity, reduce operating expenses, smooth earnings, and enhance exit valuations. Learn more.
articles.title: Evan Meyerson writes for European Financial Review about the value of legal finance for private equity

articles.summary: Global Arbitration Review (GAR) reports that the UK Ministry of Justice will bring forward legislation to address uncertainty created by the Supreme Court’s PACCAR ruling and includes remarks from CEO Christopher Bogart, who welcomes the move as an important step toward restoring certainty in the UK legal market. Learn more.
articles.title: UK Government moves to reverse PACCAR decision, Global Arbitration Review reports

articles.summary: CEO Christopher Bogart was featured in CDR's reporting on the UK government's intention to reverse the PACCAR decision. Bogart says, "Restoring clarity around the enforceability of litigation funding agreements is an important step for the UK’s globally respected legal system, and we welcome the Government’s commitment to providing that certainty." Learn more.
articles.title: Christopher Bogart featured in CDR's coverage of the UK government's intention to reverse PACCAR
